previous_live_snapshot.note: Retained provenance only; this offline preview does not silently merge live values into its illustrative controls.

durable_facts.effective_utilization: u_eff = reported utilization + sum(q95(unsettled dispatches in the same bucket))
durable_facts.guard: max(0.5 pp integer-display guard, p95 unobserved telemetry-lag burn, residual/drift guard)
durable_facts.reserve_semantics: critical reserve is dynamic q95 remaining critical demand, not a permanent fixed percentage
durable_facts.in_flight: in-flight turns are not interrupted; the next dispatch is gated
durable_facts.bootstrap_boundary: full controller uses p50/p90/p95 moving-block bootstrap of same plan/regime hourly increments; this preview does not implement that estimator

illustrative_preview.label: operator-configurable examples before #318 calibration; not measured facts and not a production contract

acceptance_examples.early_80: h=160, usage=80 => Sol HOLD and Luna HOLD
acceptance_examples.late_80: h=8, usage=80 => Luna ALLOW under illustrative defaults (Sol also fits)
acceptance_examples.between_corridors: h=40, usage=85 => Sol HOLD and Luna ALLOW under illustrative defaults
acceptance_examples.hard_fit: h=0, usage=98 => Luna HOLD because u_eff + q95 + guard > B

non_goals: No live telemetry or network calls
No claim that the 2D illustrative corridors are the calibrated #285 bootstrap controller
